I’m blind. It’s just one more struggle. I used to be able to. I think the childproof packaging should still be an option for those who need it. For the elderly and disabled, it isn’t practical. Change Reese’s Law!

It’s more dangerous to me to try opening the package as it requires me to cut the package with scissors and rip it apart thus all batteries in the package comes out at once when I only need one. I retorted having to buy a special storage case so I can conveniently open it when I need it. Go back to the package that had tabs built in them.
